You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: c024 (decay<=0.5, ignore_net_degree halved, adam scheme, per-net weight cap 7.84) is the strongest robust candidate; the cap is the only active knob, and history shows a consistent monotone trend (3.92 -> 7.84 improved all cases), so a modest x2 relaxation of the cap to 15.68 should let the worst paths retain more weight without starving moderate nets, improving WNS/TNS broadly.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.894 robust(mean-std)=+0.254 min_case=+0.245 all_valid=True

Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: relaxing the cap to 15.68 improved all three cases (robust +0.254, min +0.245, all valid). Gains are broadest on bp-ng45 (dWNS +31.8%, dTNS +38.1%) and bp_fe-ng45 (dTNS +36.1%), consistent with worst paths retaining more weight without starving moderate nets. Next step: probe cap=31.36 to test whether the monotone trend continues or saturates, and check overflow headroom (~109–133) before further relaxation.
